senses.en_definition: Possibly the proper name Hagen, used as a personal name or place name; the intended referent and any independent Malay lexical meaning remain unverified.

senses.nuances: 这是候选专名分析，并非已核实的 DBP 释义。Duden 分别收录男性名字 Hagen 和德国北莱茵—威斯特法伦州城市 Hagen，不能据此断定输入必指其中之一。以下搭配为说明性组合，例句为自拟教学例句，不代表已验证的高频搭配或语料引文。参见 [Duden：人名 Hagen](https://www.duden.de/rechtschreibung/Hagen_Vorname) 与 [Duden：城市 Hagen](https://www.duden.de/rechtschreibung/Hagen_Stadt)。

etymology.historical_story: Hagen illustrates how a foreign proper name can appear in Malay text without becoming an ordinary Malay word. Duden records Hagen both as a masculine given name, exemplified by Hagen von Tronje in the Nibelung legend, and as a German city name. These attestations establish possible name uses; they do not establish this packet’s intended referent or a Malay etymology. Sources: [given name](https://www.duden.de/rechtschreibung/Hagen_Vorname), [city](https://www.duden.de/rechtschreibung/Hagen_Stadt).
